aggregation: micro: sum TP/FP/FN globally; family metrics descriptive, never macro replacement
annotation_policy: Frozen person visible extent; recognizable visible operators inside machinery remain PERSON; no occupancy or pedestrian relevance filtering.
claims_limitations: Object detection PERSON only; not industrial safety, accident/near-miss, tracking, rules, operator identity or risk validation.
No exclusion claim regarding external pretraining.
Descriptive bounded-source evidence; PV-01 still requires contextual/expert validation.
No AP/mAP in V1; no threshold sweeps.
inference_procedure: Verify protocol/dataset freeze/weights hashes and software versions before loading any model. Abort on mismatch.
One authorized valid run per predeclared model; reference baseline cannot select a winner or replace CURRENT_PERSON automatically.
Stable images sorted by source_group then filename; original PNG decoded as BGR uint8, no resampling or annotation edits.
Seed Python/NumPy/PyTorch with 0; CUDA device 0 explicit; batch 1; no AMP/half/TTA; use pinned Ultralytics predict defaults explicitly listed in inference contract.
Mirror Operix YoloDetector detection semantics: predict all model classes with class-aware NMS then filter output class name person. No tracker, occupant filter, zones or rules.
Model eval mode, gradients disabled; use predict inference API. No GPU bitwise determinism guarantee.
Store exact post-NMS xyxy in original image pixels and confidence without rounding; stable_index is the original output box index, before the person filter.
Each image has a raw frame envelope, including zero-prediction images; context (dataset/model/config/software) is inherited by every enclosed prediction.
Write immutable raw predictions, compute predeclared metrics, hash/seal raw and results and receipt, only then inspect errors visually.
person_v2: NOT_A_CANDIDATE. If developed using holdout insights, this holdout cannot later be claimed independent final evaluation for v2.
prohibited_actions: universal post-hoc industrial precision/recall pass threshold

run_policy.artifact_location: Outside Git; exclusive creation, no overwrites. No real predictions or metrics created by protocol preparation.
run_policy.invalidation_rule: Append a technical invalidation receipt referencing the failed run; preserve original outputs. Document bug, correct and test without detector-result-driven changes; same dataset/model/config required. Never select the better of multiple attempts.
run_policy.qualitative_review: Only after raw predictions and metrics are sealed by SHA-256.

schema_validation: Closed local subset: type,properties,required,additionalProperties,items,enum,minimum,maximum; additional semantic checks in person_protocol.py.

secondary_metrics.multi_person_recall: micro recall at IoU 0.50 over the 42 frames with >=2 human GT boxes
secondary_metrics.negative_frame_false_alarm_rate: negative images with >=1 FP at IoU 0.50 / 24
secondary_metrics.positive_frame_complete_miss_rate: positive images with zero matched GT at IoU 0.50 / 67

tooling_hash_normalization: UTF-8 source text with universal newline normalization to LF; canonical protocol SHA is over the parsed manifest serialized as canonical JSON UTF-8+LF.

zero_denominators.F1: 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); null if denominator=0, zero for complete miss with GT
